check.ai.disc.apple: Note: conservative estimates for Apple Silicon unified memory + Q4; real results also depend on quantization, context length, and concurrent load.
check.ai.disc.dgpu: Note: Intel + dGPU scores with “VRAM budget ≈ discrete VRAM − 1GB”; spill into system RAM is “Tight”. Shared iGPU memory is not counted. Usually slower than similar Apple Silicon.
check.ai.disc.igpu: Note: without dGPU, effective budget ≈ 40% of (system RAM − 10GB), with a compute demotion. Shared iGPU memory is not dedicated VRAM.
check.ai.loading: Reading GPU / VRAM and evaluating models…
check.ai.no_fit: With current VRAM/RAM budget, this Mac is a poor fit for mainstream local open models — use cloud APIs or switch to Apple Silicon.
check.ai.notice.dgpu: Intel + discrete GPU: scoring uses “%@” %.0f GB VRAM; models that spill into system RAM are marked “Tight” (offload, usually slow).
check.ai.notice.igpu: Intel without discrete GPU: no unified memory; effective budget is tightened from system RAM — prefer models under ~4B.
check.ai.sub.apple: Apple Silicon uses unified memory — local LLMs mainly depend on RAM size. Estimates below use this Mac’s unified memory.
check.ai.sub.intel_dgpu: Intel Macs are not unified memory: local GPU inference depends mainly on discrete VRAM; system RAM is for offload. Estimates prioritize discrete VRAM.
check.ai.sub.intel_igpu: Intel Mac without usable discrete GPU: local inference mostly uses CPU / iGPU — do not treat whole-system RAM as VRAM.
check.ai.sub.loading: Reading GPU / VRAM in the background; evaluation follows…
check.ai.title: Local AI Model Fit
